flags.name: Disable visual effects on software rendering
flags.description: Turns off pseudo-acrylic blur effects when the GPU renderer appears to be software (e.g. SwiftShader, Microsoft Basic Render Driver).

choices.name: Default
choices.description: Use the default behavior for this flag.

choices.name: Enable (use ForceEffectMode=2)
choices.description: Disable effects on software rendering, but keep effects enabled if HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Dwm\ForceEffectMode is 2 (useful for Hyper-V VMs).

choices.name: Enable (ignore ForceEffectMode=2)
choices.description: Disable effects on software rendering even if ForceEffectMode=2 is set.

choices.name: Disable
choices.description: Do not change visual effects based on software rendering.

flags.name: Use system proxy for requests
flags.description: When enabled, outbound HTTP(S) requests can use proxy settings from the environment / OS. When disabled, requests bypass system proxy settings.

choices.name: Default
choices.description: Use the default behavior for this flag.

choices.name: Enable
choices.description: Allow HTTP clients to use system/environment proxy settings.

choices.name: Disable
choices.description: Do not use system/environment proxy settings for outbound HTTP requests.

flags.name: Show display name in expanded greeting
flags.description: When enabled, the dashboard greeting will include a detected display name while the feed is expanded (e.g. 'Good morning, GitHub Copilot!').

choices.name: Default
choices.description: Use the default behavior for this flag.

choices.name: Enable
choices.description: Enable display name detection using the default method for your OS.

choices.name: Enable (force win)
choices.description: Force the Windows method to get the display name.

choices.name: Enable (force darwin)
choices.description: Force the macOS method to get the display name.

choices.name: Enable (force linux)
choices.description: Force the Linux/Unix method to get the display name.

choices.name: Enable (force accmail)
choices.description: Use userfeedconfig.json account.email as the display name.

choices.name: Enable (force MaArCr)
choices.description: Force the display name to be 'maia arson crimew' (skips detection).

choices.name: Disable
choices.description: Do not include a display name in the expanded greeting.
